statement: In New York City, counts of new-building (NB) permit rows overstate new buildings: each NB job carries several permit rows, and fewer jobs reach a certificate of occupancy and a recorded year built than are permitted.

graph_evidence.summary: Population growth rate and expansion rate of construction land, Chongqing over 20 years (coefficient 1.82; doi:10.1117/12.815931). The only construction-supply finding found in the graph.

Vacant housing demolitions and change in crime, mean difference -0.068 (CI -0.119 to -0.018), PMID 36228876. Shows the graph treats land and buildings as exposures for health and crime, not as supply outcomes.

Variable and concept searches (13 terms, data/derived/construction/graph_search.json) found no finding on building permits, permit-to-completion ratios, lags or permit lapse. The construction concept (COEFxSZVXO) has 3 relationships in all (wage, population growth, natural disasters).

literature.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, New Residential Construction, methodology and 'Relationship between building permits, starts and completions'
literature.finding: Construction is undertaken for all but a very small percentage of units authorized by permit; an older bridge table puts abandonment before start near 1.5% and after start near 0.5%. Counts are housing units, not permit rows.

literature.citation: NYU Furman Center, State of New York City's Housing and Neighborhoods / 2019 data on the housing stock
literature.finding: Median time from new-building permit to certificate of occupancy was about 1.9 years for buildings permitted in 2009-2014.

prediction.magnitude: Legacy DOB Permit Issuance (ipu4-2q9a), job_type NB, issued 2010-2019: rows per unique NB job between 3 and 10, with renewals at least 20% of rows. Unique NB jobs with a permit, per year 2010-2019: 1,500 to 4,500. PLUTO lots with yearbuilt in 2012-2021 per year: 40% to 100% of NB jobs permitted two years before.
prediction.support_if: rows per job >= 3 in every year 2010-2019 AND jobs reaching any CO (bs8b-p36w or pkdm-hqz6) are fewer than jobs permitted, for cohorts 2010-2017
prediction.refute_if: rows per job < 2 in most years, or CO jobs roughly equal permitted jobs (ratio > 0.97) for cohorts 2010-2017

plan: SoQL aggregation by year of issuance on ipu4-2q9a (job_type='NB'): count of rows, count distinct job__, rows by filing_status (INITIAL/RENEWAL) and permit_type. DOB NOW NB jobs from w9ak-ipjd/rbx6-tga4 for 2021-2025. Join unique NB job numbers (first NB permit year) to CO records in bs8b-p36w (job_number, job_type NB) and pkdm-hqz6 (job_filing_name prefix, job_type New Building) to get the year of first CO. Compare with DCP Housing Database (br6q-ssj3) new-building completions by compltyear and PLUTO (64uk-42ks) count of lots by yearbuilt. Unit: NB job; years 2010-2025. Figure: funnel of rows, jobs, jobs with CO, HDB completions, PLUTO yearbuilt.
alternatives: Jobs that are superseded or refiled under a new job number (the building is built, under another job)
CO records missing from open data or issued under a different job number (temporary CO only, or PAA)
PLUTO yearbuilt is estimated and often recorded late or not updated after demolition and rebuild
Recent cohorts are right-censored (not yet finished)
